## What it is \{#what-it-is}

Funding the escrow reserves your payment for a deal. <RoleBadge role="buyer" /> only.

## Step by step \{#how-to}

<Steps>
<Step title="Open Deals">
Choose **Deals** in the sidebar, then pick the deal.
<Screenshot name="buyer/deals" route="/app/deals" as="buyer" alt="The deals list" />
</Step>
<Step title="Fund the escrow">
Press <Kbd>Fund</Kbd> to create a <TierBadge tier={2} /> approval.
</Step>
</Steps>

<Callout type="security" title="Simulated">
No real money moves.
</Callout>

## FAQ \{#faq}

<FAQ>
<FAQItem q="Can I undo a deposit?">
Ask for a refund from the deal page.
</FAQItem>
</FAQ>
